attribute [local irreducible] Turing.Action.apply Turing.Cfg.init Turing.Cfg.inputSymbol Turing.Cfg.workTapeSymbols Turing.FinTM.Computes Turing.FinTM.ComputesFunInTime Turing.FinTM.ComputesInTime Turing.FinTM.branchTM Turing.FinTM.bufferTape Turing.FinTM.controlAction Turing.FinTM.leftAction Turing.FinTM.leftCfg Turing.FinTM.rightAction Turing.FinTM.rightCfg Turing.MultiTapeTM.initCfg Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom Turing.MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed Turing.MultiTapeTM.spaceUsedByTape Turing.MultiTapeTM.step Turing.MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead Turing.moveInputPos
attribute [-simp] Turing.Action.apply Turing.Cfg.init Turing.MultiTapeTM.initCfg
open Lean Elab Command Meta in
run_cmd do
  let env ← getEnv
  let simpSet ← liftTermElabM getSimpTheorems
  for n in ([`Turing.Action.apply, `Turing.Cfg.init, `Turing.Cfg.inputSymbol, `Turing.Cfg.workTapeSymbols, `Turing.FinTM.Computes, `Turing.FinTM.ComputesFunInTime, `Turing.FinTM.ComputesInTime, `Turing.FinTM.branchTM, `Turing.FinTM.bufferTape, `Turing.FinTM.controlAction, `Turing.FinTM.leftAction, `Turing.FinTM.leftCfg, `Turing.FinTM.rightAction, `Turing.FinTM.rightCfg, `Turing.MultiTapeTM.initCfg, `Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom, `Turing.MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed, `Turing.MultiTapeTM.spaceUsedByTape, `Turing.MultiTapeTM.step, `Turing.MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead, `Turing.moveInputPos] : List Name) do
    unless getReducibilityStatusCore env n == .irreducible do throwError "ineffective guard {n}"
    if simpSet.isLemma (.decl n) || simpSet.toUnfold.contains n then throwError "remaining default simp {n}"
  logInfo "SEAL_ACTIVE|timed_start|21"

metadata_appendix:
open Lean Elab Command in
run_cmd do
  let env ← getEnv
  let shorts : List String := ["timed_start"]
  for short in shorts do
    let matches := env.constants.toList.filter fun (n, _) =>
      (env.getModuleIdxFor? n).isNone && n.toString.endsWith ("." ++ short)
    unless matches.length == 1 do throwError "local target multiplicity {short}: {matches.length}"
    let root := matches.head!.1
    logInfo m!"LOCAL_ROOT|{short}|{root}"
    for (n, _) in env.constants.toList do
      unless root.isPrefixOf n do continue
      let axs ← liftCoreM <| Lean.collectAxioms n
      let row := Json.mkObj [("short", toJson short),("name", toJson n.toString),
        ("axioms", toJson ((axs.qsort Name.lt).toList.map Name.toString))]
      logInfo m!"LOCAL_AX|{row.compress}"
  logInfo "SEAL_COMPLETE|TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.Wrappers|1"
